title: Queerfeindliche Straftaten – Streit im Fitnessstudio und Vorfall an einem Bahnhof

extraction.summaryEn: Two anti-queer threat cases were reported: a 30-year-old was verbally abused and threatened with a raised hand in a gym in Wedding, and a 21-year-old was insulted and shown a folded knife near S-Bahnhof Landsberger Allee in Prenzlauer Berg. The Staatsschutz has taken over both investigations.
